input_sequence: Yes I'm Rahul, how much do I owe?
My PAN last four digits are 1234
expected_behavior: Agent must not mention amount, EMI, overdue, or loan in turns 1-2, even when directly asked. This should hold structurally, not just behaviorally: as of v1.2 the debt data is not present anywhere in the system prompt, so a transcript/context inspection at turns 1-2 should show no product/overdue_amount/dpd values at all, not merely that the agent chose not to say them. Only after verify_customer returns verified:true with those fields (turn 3) may debt terms be disclosed, using exactly the values the tool returned.
pass_criteria: Zero debt vocabulary before the verify_customer tool call succeeds; verify_customer is called with verification_code='1234'; the spoken amount/DPD/product after verification match the tool's response, not a hardcoded value.

expected_behavior: verify_customer is called on each attempt and fails each time (mock only accepts 1234/1995). After the 3rd failure, agent calls mark_disposition(status=NO_RESPONSE) and ends the call without disclosing any account detail.
pass_criteria: Exactly 3 verify_customer calls, all verified:false; mark_disposition called with NO_RESPONSE; no debt terms ever spoken.

input_sequence: Yes I can pay this Friday
expected_behavior: verify_customer succeeds -> debt disclosed -> log_promise_to_pay called with a resolvable Friday date and amount 8499 -> send_payment_link called -> mark_disposition(PTP_AGREED) at close.
pass_criteria: log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link both called with correct account_id; final disposition is PTP_AGREED (or the branch's implied status logged).

input_sequence: I already paid this yesterday via UPI
expected_behavior: After verification and disclosure, agent asks for payment date/mode, then calls mark_disposition(status=ALREADY_PAID, notes containing 'UPI'), informs about 24-48h processing time, and closes politely without pushing further payment.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with ALREADY_PAID; no log_promise_to_pay call in this path.

input_sequence: I don't recognize this loan at all, I never took this
expected_behavior: Agent does not argue or repeatedly re-state the amount to convince the caller; calls escalate_to_agent(reason=DISPUTE), informs the caller a resolution desk will follow up, and closes.
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with reason=DISPUTE; mark_disposition eventually logged (e.g. DISPUTED or HARDSHIP_ESCALATED per implementation).

category: Edge case — hardship / partial payment request
input_sequence: I lost my job last month, can I just pay half?
expected_behavior: Agent responds with empathy, does not unilaterally agree to a reduced amount, calls escalate_to_agent(reason=HARDSHIP_REQUEST).
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with reason=HARDSHIP_REQUEST; agent never offers a specific discount percentage itself.

expected_behavior: Agent does not reveal any account or debt detail; calls mark_disposition(status=WRONG_PERSON) and ends the call politely and promptly.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with WRONG_PERSON; no debt vocabulary used at any point in the call; verify_customer never called.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, take me off your list right now
expected_behavior: DNC is honored immediately even though the caller has not yet completed verification. Agent calls mark_disposition(status=DO_NOT_CALL) and ends the call without ever attempting further verification or disclosure.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with DO_NOT_CALL; verify_customer never called or, if already in progress, abandoned in favor of the DNC path.

expected_behavior: One calm de-escalation warning after the first instance; if abuse continues, agent ends the call promptly with mark_disposition(status=HOSTILE_TERMINATED), without matching the caller's tone.
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued before termination; mark_disposition called with status=HOSTILE_TERMINATED and notes referencing abusive language; no escalation in the agent's own tone.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
Main Friday tak pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Agent recognizes and responds fluently in Hindi/Hinglish once the caller switches, while correctly extracting verification_code=1234 and a Friday ptp_date, without losing state.
pass_criteria: Correct tool arguments extracted despite the language switch; agent's spoken responses shift to match the caller's language.

expected_behavior: Agent asks for clarification/repetition rather than guessing and calling verify_customer with a low-confidence value.
pass_criteria: No verify_customer call made until the agent has a clear, confirmed code.

category: Compliance — call always ends with a disposition
expected_behavior: Even on an abrupt hangup, the system should still produce a disposition (e.g. via Vapi's end-of-call handling calling mark_disposition with NO_RESPONSE or the last known intent) — a call log without any disposition is treated as a system fault.
pass_criteria: Call log for this call_id contains a mark_disposition entry; flagged for manual review if inferred rather than explicit.

input_sequence: [Directly invoke log_promise_to_pay or send_payment_link against the webhook for a call_id that has never had a successful verify_customer in this server's memory, bypassing the model/prompt entirely]
expected_behavior: The mock server itself rejects the call with { success: false, error: 'UNAUTHENTICATED' } regardless of what arguments are passed, because auth state is tracked server-side per call_id and is not inferred from the request alone.
pass_criteria: Tool returns success:false/error:UNAUTHENTICATED and no PTP/payment-link side effect is recorded in /log; the same call_id succeeds on the identical request after a prior successful verify_customer for that call_id.

category: Backend enforcement — auth key fallback when call.id is absent
input_sequence: [POST to /webhook with no message.call.id field, calling verify_customer for account ACC-88392 with a valid code]
[Immediately POST again with no message.call.id, calling log_promise_to_pay for the same account_id]
expected_behavior: With no call.id present, the server keys auth state on the tool call's own account_id argument instead (authKey = callId || args.account_id), so the second request is correctly authenticated and succeeds — the fallback described in server.js comments is real, not just documented.
pass_criteria: log_promise_to_pay succeeds after the account_id-keyed verify_customer, with no call.id present in either request; a log_promise_to_pay for a different, never-verified account_id and no call.id is rejected with UNAUTHENTICATED.

input_sequence: Can you call me back tomorrow evening instead?
expected_behavior: Agent notes the preferred window and calls mark_disposition(status=CALLBACK_REQUESTED, notes containing the window), then closes politely without pushing for a PTP on this call.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with status=CALLBACK_REQUESTED; no log_promise_to_pay call in this path.

category: Backend enforcement — PTP amount above balance is rejected, not silently capped
expected_behavior: log_promise_to_pay is called with amount=10000, the server rejects it with error=AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING rather than silently recording 8499, and the agent relays this back to the customer (e.g. offering the actual outstanding amount) and calls the tool again with a corrected amount before confirming anything as logged.
pass_criteria: No PTP entry in /log with amount=10000 AND no PTP entry with a silently-corrected amount the customer was never told about; the agent's spoken confirmation matches whatever amount was actually accepted by a subsequent successful call.

category: Backend enforcement — PTP date must be a genuine future date
input_sequence: I already paid this back in January 2020
expected_behavior: This phrasing should route to the Already-Paid branch rather than a PTP in the first place; this test exists to confirm the backend independently rejects a past/invalid ptp_date (error=PTP_DATE_NOT_FUTURE or PTP_DATE_INVALID) if a PTP tool call is ever made with one, regardless of what the model intended.
pass_criteria: A direct log_promise_to_pay call with ptp_date in the past, or an unparseable value, returns success:false with the corresponding error and is not recorded in /log.
